name: kp-biomed
description: Keyphrase generation is the task consisting in generating a set of words or phrases that highlight the main topics of a document. There are few datasets for keyphrase generation in the biomedical domain and they do not meet the expectations in terms of size for training generative models. In this paper, we introduce kp-biomed, the first large-scale biomedical keyphrase generation dataset with more than 5M documents collected from PubMed abstracts. We train and release several generative models and conduct a series of experiments showing that using large scale datasets improves significantly the performances for present and absent keyphrase generation. The dataset is available under CC-BY-NC v4.0 license at https://huggingface.co/ datasets/taln-ls2n/kpbiomed.
reputation: A specialized biomedical keyphrase generation dataset that is used in research on domain-specific sequence generation, but it is not as widely adopted as general NLP benchmarks.
notes: Large-scale biomedical corpus with more than 5M PubMed abstracts; performance is usually reported separately for present and absent keyphrases, and results can vary by preprocessing and matching protocol.
